nodes.description: INTERNSHIP PROGRAMS. Location: Director's Office. Duration: 2026-04-06T15:30:00.000Z to 2026-04-06T22:20:00.000Z. Details: Students working in the fields of Wildlife, Environment, Education, Biodiversity, Conservation and related areas are welcomed for doing their Internship at the Zoo. Hundreds of students have participated in various internship programs in National Zoological Park in the last couple of years.

VOLUNTEERSHIP PROGRAMS. Location: Education Centre. Duration: 2026-04-08T15:30:00.000Z to 2026-04-08T19:30:00.000Z. Details: Anyone interested in working for the cause of animals, may apply for the Volunteership Programme of the National Zoological Park by writing in via mail. They will be exposed to in-situ conservation methods, taking care of animals in captivity, and other administrative or peripheral activities that are involved in the upkeep and smooth functioning of a zoo.

SUMMER VACATION PROGRAM. Location: Education Centre. Duration: 2026-05-21T10:00:00.000Z to 2026-06-06T17:00:00.000Z. Details: Summer Vacation Programme 2026
Venue: Education centre, National Zoological Park, New Delhi
Time: 08:30 AM to 11:30 AM
Slot A : 21st May 2026 to 28th May 2026
Slot B: 30th May 2026 to 4th June 2026
Participants (for both slots): Junior category (Class 6 to Class 8) and Senior category (Class 9 to Class 12)

Eligible students are invited to register for participation in the programme. Submission of this form does not guarantee selection, which will be subjected to availability of seats and confirmation by the National Zoological Park, New Delhi.
